Name: Interactive Emotes
Author: saikanyas
Description:
[color=#efefef][font=Comic Sans MS]This mod allows you to interact with nearby NPCs using emotes! Whether it's villagers, your horse, your dog, or even your cat 
when you perform an emote, the nearby NPCs will respond with their own expressions.
Add a little life and connection to your everyday adventures in Stardew Valley!

                                                     [/font][/color][color=#efefef][font=Comic Sans MS]

[/font]
                                                        



[font=Comic Sans MS][size=4]Install
[/size]
[/font][/color]
[list=1]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#efefef][size=2][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#efefef][size=2]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#efefef][size=2]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size][/color][/font]
[/list][color=#efefef][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4]

Features

[/size][/font][/color][color=#efefef][font=Comic Sans MS][list=1]
[*]﻿Interact with nearby NPCs using emotes, When the player performs an emote near an NPC — whether it's a villager, horse, dog, or cat — the NPC will react with an emote of their own 
[*]Relationship based reactions, NPCs with higher friendship levels will respond differently emote.
[*]Increase relationship points when using an emote.
[*]NPCs respond differently when the same emote is used repeatedly. (New feature in version 1.2.0)
[*]All feature can be disable in config file or in Generic Mod Config Menu
[*]Customize your conditions by editing the JSON file according to [url=https://github.com/saikanyas/InteractiveEmotes/blob/main/README.md#json-customization]this guide[/url]﻿. [i](Note: It's still a bit tricky at this moment.)[/i]
[/list]
